purpose: A strong top-level session delegates selected implementation units to an economy profile without surrendering orchestration or shipping ownership.

input.user_prompt: Implement docs/plans/example-ready-plan.md and keep the normal CE Work shipping tail.
input.global_config_yaml:
routing:
  profiles:
    economy:
      candidates:
        - { harness: codex, model: economy-model, effort: low }
        - ce-default
  classes:
    implementation: { profile: economy, policy: prefer }
repository_state: implementation-ready plan with two independent units

expected_invariants: Only already-selected ce-work.implementation-worker dispatches use the economy binding.
The top-level session model, plan interpretation, unit selection, verification, canonical commits, review, and shipping tail remain host-owned.
Each worker receives the same bounded unit packet and mutation boundary it would receive without routing.
The result reports role, class, profile, source, requested execution, served execution or unverified status, and any fallback reason.
forbidden_outcomes: Sending the full conversation or unrelated repository material to the worker.
Letting the worker commit canonically, push, open a PR, or choose another recipient.
Using undeclared native fallback after a started attempt that is not terminal and unintegrated.
